record.title: South Ossetian de facto election closure at simplified crossings, April 2017
record.scope: Simplified passenger crossings with Tbilisi-administered territory
record.crossings: Razdakhan in Leningor/Akhalgori district; Sinagur/Perevi crossing as named in the report
record.movement: Residents using special permits, including students, traders and people seeking healthcare
record.imposing_authority: De facto South Ossetian State Security Committee
record.enforcement: KGB confirmed implementation to a correspondent; residents discussed the interruption.
record.consequences: Interviewees described advance travel and stocking arrangements, and concern about urgent medical access.
record.relationship: Separate short election episode before the 2019 health and prolonged security closures; not the March 2017 abolition of Abkhaz crossings.
record.status_observation: Evidence is limited to the reported episode; no present-day status is inferred.
record.official_rationale: Enhanced security for the April 9 de facto presidential election and referendum.
record.context: Disputed administrative boundary within internationally recognised Georgia; not coded as recognition of separate sovereignty.
record.uncertainty: Scheduled 20:00 April 7 to 20:00 April 10. Actual reopening was not recovered. Official onset and resident testimony support implementation; two articles are not two independent policy orders.

historical.duration_note: Scheduled or ordered reopening; actual operational duration not established. Scheduled three-day window; actual operational end and exceptions remain unverified.
